characters.description: A reserved business analyst and dedicated amateur archer who trusts his intuition but usually avoids notice. He is sharing an elevator with several coworkers when the system announces Earth's initiation and sends him into the unknown.
characters.name: Jake

characters.description: The full name of the reserved analyst introduced as Jake. After awakening in the system's introduction room, he chooses Archer as his tutorial class and receives the skills and starter equipment needed to enter the Great Forest.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: Jake's wealthy, charismatic supervisor and friend. His confidence and social ease make him a natural focus for the coworkers caught in the initiation, in contrast with Jake's preference for remaining in the background.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: An HR coworker traveling with Jake's elevator group when the initiation begins. Jake is attracted to her, although her interest appears to be directed toward Jacob.
characters.name: Caroline

characters.description: A physically imposing but gentle member of the elevator group with ties to Jacob's upbringing. His size suggests strength, but his calm manner distinguishes him from a conventional enforcer.
characters.name: Bertram

characters.description: The office receptionist and one of the coworkers caught in the same elevator as Jake. She is present with her husband when the initiation begins.
characters.name: Joanna

characters.description: A coworker from research and development who reunites with Jake on the tutorial platform. He selects Archer, making him the ten-person group's second ranged weapon specialist alongside the much more practiced Jake.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: The commanding leader of a much larger armed survivor force. He presents his organization as a cooperative merger, but speaks for it alone and makes clear that Caroline's service as a healer is the central condition of his offer.
characters.name: Richard

characters.description: A member of Jake's original survivor group who receives a serious bite during a hunt. Caroline's healing and a health potion stabilize the injury, demonstrating both the danger of routine encounters and the group's dependence on medical supplies.
characters.name: Theodore

characters.description: Richard's trusted lieutenant, an experienced archer formerly employed by Richard's private security firm. He leads a seven-person stealth unit sent after Jake and remains outside Jake's immediate perception while directing the pursuit.
characters.name: Nicholas

characters.description: An unusually powerful teenage caster living at the edge of Richard's growing camp. He keeps his independence, searches for mana potions, and regards the settlement chiefly in terms of what its healers, crafters, and supplies can provide.
characters.name: Lone teen caster

characters.description: A coworker from the original tutorial group whose death is reported as the conflict between the two large survivor camps worsens. His loss is part of the mounting evidence that the supposed reprisals are consuming both factions.
characters.name: Dennis

characters.description: A participant associated with Richard's camp who is reported dead amid the escalating conflict with the rival settlement. Her death is one of several casualties attributed to the cycle of attacks between the two groups.
characters.name: Lena

characters.description: A caster in Richard's settlement whose class develops a frost specialization. He is among the camp members advancing into more defined combat roles while the conflict with the rival faction intensifies.
characters.name: Ahmed

characters.description: A Metal Savant embedded in Richard's camp who has secretly murdered parties from both major factions and arranged the evidence to prolong their war. He hides behind a frightened public manner while pursuing his goal of becoming the tutorial's sole survivor.
characters.name: William

characters.description: An ex-military survivor who leads the large camp opposing Richard's organization. His faction believes Richard's side is responsible for the continuing attacks, unaware that William is engineering violence against both settlements.
characters.name: Hayden

characters.description: The poison-focused namesake of the alchemist profession offered inside Jake's challenge dungeon. Accepting that legacy grants Jake specialized alchemical abilities but also leaves him with a dormant toxin he must cure within thirty days.
characters.name: Malefic Viper

characters.description: Casper's girlfriend, identified only after she has been murdered during the faction conflict. Her death becomes the personal loss that determines Casper's response to the killer and to the tutorial itself.
characters.name: Lyra

characters.description: The deity who has protected the diminished Malefic Order during the Malefic Viper's long absence. The Viper's return places this guardian in a position to help the order respond to its patron's renewed activity.
characters.name: Lord Protector

characters.description: The unnamed highest-ranking mortal leader of the reduced Malefic Order. An obelisk signaling the Malefic Viper's return summons her to respond to her patron's renewed activity.
characters.name: Malefic Order hallmaster

characters.description: A bearded smith who privately approaches William. He invokes their separate divine connections and opens a discussion about a secret alliance.
characters.name: Bearded smith

characters.description: The smith who equips William for the coming war and asks him to avenge family members killed by Richard's people. Hermann gives his remaining life and power to transform the armor into a soulbound Epic legacy bearing his name.
characters.name: Hermann Schmidt

characters.description: A light caster and Hayden's former second-in-command who organizes the rival camp's last defense. He counters Richard's mass assault with concealed fighters and false defectors after taking on much of the faction's planning.
characters.name: Desmond

characters.description: An unnamed, wounded rapier fighter who remains beside Desmond after their faction's defending force is reduced to the two of them.
characters.name: Wounded rapier fighter

characters.description: A smiling stranger who appears after William collapses from the destruction of Richard's force. He uses a crystal to prevent William from dying, then departs without revealing who he is.
characters.name: Unidentified man

characters.description: The leader of the badgers in Badger's Den and Jake's final target within the dungeon. She waits in the boss cavern with several Alpha Venomfang Badgers and is stronger than her subordinates.
characters.name: Den Mother

characters.description: A primordial deity who invites Jacob into her realm after his class evolves into Augur of Hope. She recruits him as a future speaker and offers her Greater Blessing in exchange for his service.
characters.name: Holy Mother

characters.description: Jake's former university roommate, recalled during a dream about an old betrayal. Jake remembers discovering that Andrew had become involved with Madeline while she was still Jake's girlfriend.
characters.name: Andrew

characters.description: Jake's former girlfriend, seen through his dream of a painful university memory. Her affair with Andrew left Jake with a betrayal he had avoided fully confronting.
characters.name: Madeline

characters.description: A hidden presence uses Andrew's likeness to enter Jake's dream and encourage distrust of Jacob. Its nature remains unknown when the Malefic Viper challenges the projection.
characters.name: Dream intruder

characters.description: The unseen ruler of four beast lords that guard separate dungeons. The Beast Lords quest requires defeating all four lords to force their king to appear.
characters.name: Unseen beast king
